observed_discontinuity: Class lookup searched every loaded DEX by descriptor, kept the first hit, and if that missed guessed a class with the same simple name.
required_semantics: Boot definitions beat an application DEX with the same descriptor.
The same descriptor under two defining loaders has two identities.
A child loader delegates to its parent before defining.
Duplicate definitions on one loader keep the earliest DEX.
Resolution does not guess by simple-name suffix.
Resolution order follows classpath insertion order.
The classpath can hold more than eight DEX files.

differences.description: Production lookup no longer substitutes a class whose simple name matches.
A class is identified by its defining loader and descriptor. Parent delegation returns the parent identity.
DEX files are stored in a growable classpath. Eight is not a load limit.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: Before this contract, dx_vm_load_class_locked selected the first descriptor match in a flat DEX list and then applied a simple-name suffix fallback.
